item.title: About
item.description:
Hey, I’m Chase — most people call me Ced.

I’m a DevOps and Cloud Infrastructure Engineer at GE Aerospace by day, homelabber by night.

I run a 6-node Proxmox VE cluster, a 12-node Raspberry Pi K3s cluster, a full observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager), a VLAN-segmented UniFi network, TrueNAS storage, and a live NOC dashboard — all out of my house.

This blog documents the real builds, real incidents, and real configs. No fluff.
